title: Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones, Teal $211.65 ($206.67 eBay Plus) Delivered @ SennheiserAustralia eBay
body:
Deal: Sennheiser Momentum 4 Wireless Over-Ear Headphones, Teal $211.65 ($206.67 eBay Plus) Delivered @ SennheiserAustralia eBay

[Elyxar] Me too. I wish manufacturers would do magenta more. So boring driving through parking lots of just black, grey and white cars. We'll put out a special edition colour!! … moon grey. Sigh.
[mynameisborat] wouldn't mess with cashback for 7.67$ mate.
[Fishballs] You do you, some might want to know the option is there. I'm not spending $200 on headphones either though.
[krammis76] Got the special edition copper version of these a week or so ago and really like them. Noise cancelling isn't the best but it's good enough and the sound quality is really great for the price. Have been using them a fair bit for the week and i'm still at about 80 percent battery. They sound amazing when used wired via usb c too.
[Wolfenstein98k] These are incredible and basically flawless at this price.
[parcus] If you don’t care about ANC and foldability sure… also noting XM4s frequently below this price
[Elyxar] Searching ozb history for xm4 only has XM4s below this price in Feb this year and that was costco and sold out fast. All other posts were for refurbished. Are you seeing them cheap somewhere else?
